title: epan: convert dissectors E to C99 types

notes.body:
added 3 commits
  • 93732787...67daaa34 - 2 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • e106fe5e - epan: convert dissectors E to C99 types
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/16435/diffs?diff_id=1065820726&start_sha=937327873202ac5e991c6dc5555c148c8da69bab)
Why don't you also change the `tvb_get_g*()` function calls?

It wasn't included in the script at the time I think. Perhaps we shouldn't
blindly change but rather use the proto...ret(u)int where aproriate.

Den tis 16 juli 2024 21:41Stig Bjørlykke (@stigbjorlykke) <
gitlab@mg.gitlab.com> skrev:
Yes, doing the manual task of changing to `proto...ret_(u)int()` when appropriate is also a good improvement. But maybe as a separate task?

Yes.

Den tis 16 juli 2024 23:58Stig Bjørlykke (@stigbjorlykke) <
gitlab@mg.gitlab.com> skrev:
